Type: paisley jacquard throw pillow
Use: on a sofa, armchair or bed; living room, bedroom
Style: traditional, classic
Materials: woven jacquard fabric
Colors: medium grey, light silver grey
Shape: square, large all-over tonal paisley pattern with fine floral detail, subtle sheen, knife edges, compact
Feel: elegant, soft, refined, calm
Goes with: grey, white or navy sofas, dark wood, silver accents; traditional or transitional rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Ravenna Home Classic Paisley Throw Pillow - 17 x 17 Inch, Grey
product.description: Cover: 100% polyester, Stuffing: 100% polyester Made in the United States of imported materials 17"L x 17"W The beautiful paisley pattern featured on the front and back of this pillow can bring a touch of sophistication to your space. Spot clean. Put in dryer on low heat for 20 minutes to release wrinkles, or use garment steamer. Do not iron.
